name: DiskIn
description: Stream in audio from a file. Continuously plays a longer soundfile from disk via a buffer preloaded with one buffer size of sound.

inputs.name: numChannels
inputs.description: Number of channels in the buffer (must match the buffer; fixed at SynthDef compile time)

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer number to stream from (numFrames must be a power of two; >=65536 recommended)

name: DiskOut
description: Record to a soundfile to disk via a buffer prepared with Buffer.write (leaveOpen=true).

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer number to write to (prepared with /b_write or Buffer.write; numFrames must be a power of two)

inputs.name: channelsArray
inputs.description: Array of channels to write to the file (channel count must match the buffer)

name: VDiskIn
description: Stream in audio from a file with variable playback rate. Like DiskIn, but supports a rate input for varispeed playback.

inputs.name: numChannels
inputs.description: Number of channels in the buffer (must match the buffer; fixed at SynthDef compile time)

inputs.name: bufnum
inputs.description: Buffer number to stream from (numFrames must be a power of two; >=65536 recommended)

inputs.name: rate
inputs.description: Playback rate (1.0 = normal speed; rate < bufSize/(2*blockSize))

inputs.name: sendID
inputs.description: OSC reply ID; if non-zero, sends ['/diskin', nodeID, sendID, frame] on each buffer reload
